g.text: C Proxies outside the raw cap
V9: raw proxy norms cross the cap while mapped depth saturates
Epoch 0: saved pre-first-update state. Other points: epoch end. Bands show proxy min–max, not uncertainty.
Outside raw-cap and near-mapped-cap counts coincide at these epoch ends (mapped threshold 4.5999).
